design_note: v2 fills ~2 min with repeated A..I cycles. Generator refuses to write if effective audio <85% (v1 mistake: ~40 s packets + ~80 s silence).

kiss_expectation: TNC should emit KISS DATA with payload bytes only (no FCS)
